# What will this terraform apply add to the monthly AWS bill?

> Paste a Terraform plan (terraform show -json) and get an approximate monthly AWS cost delta before you apply: top cost drivers, an honest list of what it could not price, and a budget threshold for CI. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. An offline alternative to Infracost for the common AWS resources.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
